mapper.select: SELECT id, tenant_id, checklist_item_id, result_version, result_source_code, fact_description, collection_task_id, collection_result_reference_id, collection_result_version, external_source_code, query_time, load_failure_code, selection_start_time, selection_end_time, select_user_id, selection_reason_code, current_marker, create_user_id, create_time, deleted, field_definition_id, base_checklist_result_id, device_id, command_template_id, collection_log_id, collection_status_code, collection_failure_code, original_failed_collection_task_id, original_failed_result_version, original_failure_code FROM cut_cutover_checklist_item_result WHERE tenant_id = #{query.tenantId} AND checklist_item_id = #{query.checklistItemId} AND current_marker = 1 AND deleted = b'0' FOR UPDATE

SELECT r.id, r.tenant_id, r.checklist_item_id, r.result_version, r.result_source_code, r.fact_description, r.collection_task_id, r.collection_result_reference_id, r.collection_result_version, r.external_source_code, r.query_time, r.load_failure_code, r.selection_start_time, r.selection_end_time, r.select_user_id, r.selection_reason_code, r.current_marker, r.create_user_id, r.create_time, r.deleted, r.field_definition_id, r.base_checklist_result_id, r.device_id, r.command_template_id, r.collection_log_id, r.collection_status_code, r.collection_failure_code, r.original_failed_collection_task_id, r.original_failed_result_version, r.original_failure_code FROM cut_cutover_checklist_item_result r JOIN cut_cutover_checklist_item i ON i.tenant_id = r.tenant_id AND i.id = r.checklist_item_id AND i.checklist_id = #{query.checklistId} AND i.deleted = b'0' WHERE r.tenant_id = #{query.tenantId} AND r.current_marker = 1 AND r.deleted = b'0' ORDER BY i.stable_item_key, r.id
